title: 第21章 前往灵霄宗第22章 成为外门弟子
content_zh:
“天高云淡，微风徐徐，这天气真适合出游。”
“要是有几个漂亮妹子陪着，那就更爽了。”
“话说这世界的妹子好像也没那那么多好看的啊，怎么别的小说里面，见一个女的就是大美女，我这啥都没有，我还想过过眼瘾呢。”
“可能是新手村的原因？到了灵霄宗眼睛那不得不够用了。嘿嘿。”
“几点了啊，大哥应该不会迟到吧。”
“我就说这里缺了钟表，太不方便了。”
辉月城东的分叉路口，叶非凡躲在一棵大树的上面，看向辉月城的方向，脑海里甚至进行了一番YY。
1个时辰后，只见叶飞扬从辉月城得方向慢慢走来，旁边没有任何随行人员，等他走到约定地点后，四处望了望，没有发现叶非凡的踪影，便站在路口静静等待。
叶非凡在树上稍微等了会，周边没什么人之后便下去找叶飞扬汇合。
“飞扬大哥，我在这呢，早就到了，怕被其他人看到，我就躲到了树上，嘿嘿。”
“嗯，这样也好，你行李都收拾好了吗？”
“都收拾好了，也没啥要带了，就是大哥之前给的微型聚灵阵和固灵佩，再加上几套换洗的衣物，其他的也没有什么东西了。”
“上次我给的灵石应该已经用完了吧，老祖出发前给了我一些灵石，不过我看你暂时也没地方放，就先给你几块拿着修炼吧，等到了灵霄宗后，我隔一段时间就过来给你一点。”
说着，叶飞扬就拿出10块下品灵石给叶非凡。
“那就谢谢飞扬大哥了，我还正愁没有灵石用了，这好好的聚灵阵不能用上实在是太浪费了。”
叶非凡也没有客气，连忙收好灵石，这可是他练级的宝贵资源。
“那大哥，咱们现在就出发吗？这灵霄宗在哪啊，我们怎么去。”
“老祖已经帮我们准备好地图了。按照预计，在前面的村庄里面，我们买上2匹马，跟着地图走，大概30日就能到了。”
“30日？还是骑马？这距离有点远啊。”
叶非凡惊讶不已。

“嗯，灵霄宗可是阳州域的大宗门，所属势力范围就很大了，再加上咱们辉月城不在灵霄宗的势力范围内，过去的话还是很费时间的。”
叶飞扬知道叶非凡是第一次出远门，怕是很多地方还不太懂，就简单的说明了下地理情况。
“走吧，先去前面一点的村庄买两匹马。”
叶飞扬说完，便带头向前走去。
“好的。”
叶非凡听到后，便戴上帽子，同时给脸上胡乱抹了些灰尘，尽量让自己不会轻易被认出来。
看着叶非凡的操作，叶飞扬没有说什么，但是心里对叶非凡的评价又上升了一点。
叶飞扬只是说不要让大家知道叶非凡跟着自己一起去了灵霄宗，却是并没有说更多的细节，也确实是他没有在这方面想太多，但见到叶非凡的行动后，心里有点承认自己还做得不够好，还好叶非凡稍微弥补了一下。
“大哥，我看你腰间一直别着一把长剑，你是剑修吗？”
叶非凡一边和叶飞扬前行，一边忍不住问道。
这个问题他一直很好奇，毕竟以前的小说中剑修都是战力无双的存在，如果大哥是剑修的话，那在灵霄宗里面，自己可能能过得更舒服点，毕竟靠山越强越好。
“我不是剑修，我只是选择了剑方向的武技，所以我就一直带着剑。”
“那大哥你有希望成为剑修吗？剑修是不是都很厉害。”
叶非凡继续追问。
“很难，我以前外出游历的时候碰到过剑修，他们在同境界中的战斗力的确要高不少，我也试图学习如何成为剑修，但一直没有入门，听说是需要掌握剑意才行，可惜我没有感受到任何剑意，也许我在这方面没有天赋吧。”
叶飞扬似乎有成为剑修的打算，但是一直没有成功。
“那大哥这次成为灵霄宗弟子后，就有希望成为剑修了吧。
毕竟那么大的宗门，肯定有剑修存在，到时候能拜师的话，就更好了。”
叶非凡极力赞同叶飞扬成为剑修，背靠大树好乘凉。
“你想的太简单了，咱们整个阳州域都没有出名的大剑修，更别提灵霄宗了，我听说在别的域中有专门的剑修门派，可惜离我们太远了。”

“啊，那真是太可惜了。”
叶非凡是真的感觉到可惜，不仅为叶飞扬可惜，也为自己可惜，说实话，叶非凡也是有成为剑修的梦想的。
content_en:
"The sky is high and the clouds are clear, and the breeze is gentle. This weather is really suitable for traveling."
"It would be even better if there were a few beautiful girls accompanying me."
"Speaking of which, there don't seem to be that many pretty girls in this world. Why, in other novels, every woman you see is a beautiful woman. I have nothing like that. I even thought about eye addiction."
"Maybe it's because of the Novice Village? It will be enough for Lingxiao Sect's eyes. Hehe."
"What time is it? Brother should not be late."
"I just said it's too inconvenient that there's a clock missing here."
At the fork in the east of Huiyue City, Ye Feifan hid on a big tree, looking in the direction of Huiyue City, and even had some sexual intercourse in his mind.
An hour later, Ye Feiyang was seen walking slowly from the direction of Huiyue City. There was no one accompanying him. When he arrived at the agreed place, he looked around and found no sign of Ye Feiyang, so he stood at the intersection and waited quietly.
Ye Feifan waited on the tree for a while. After there was no one around, he went down to meet Ye Feiyang.
"Brother Feiyang, I'm here. I've been here a long time ago. I was afraid of being seen by others, so I hid in the tree, hehe."
"Well, that's fine. Have you packed your luggage?"
"It's all packed up. There's nothing else to bring. It's just the miniature spirit gathering array and solid spirit pendant that big brother gave me before, plus a few sets of changes of clothes. There's not much else left."
"The spirit stones I gave you last time must have been used up. The ancestor gave me some spirit stones before setting off, but I think you don't have anywhere to put them for the time being, so I'll give you a few to practice with. When you get to Lingxiao Sect, I'll come over and give you some after a while."
With that said, Ye Feiyang took out 10 low-grade spiritual stones and gave them to Ye Feifan.
"Then thank you, Brother Feiyang. I'm still worried about running out of spirit stones. It would be such a waste if I can't use this good spirit gathering array."
Ye Feifan was not polite and quickly collected the spirit stones, which were precious resources for him to level up.
"Brother, shall we set off now? Where is Lingxiao Sect and how do we get there?"
"The ancestor has prepared a map for us. According to the prediction, we will buy two horses in the village ahead and follow the map. We will arrive there in about 30 days."
"On the 30th? Or riding a horse? It's a bit far away."
Ye Feifan was surprised.
"Well, Lingxiao Sect is a major sect in Yangzhou Region, and its sphere of influence is very large. In addition, our Huiyue City is not within the sphere of influence of Lingxiao Sect, so it will still be very time-consuming to get there."
Ye Feiyang knew that it was Ye Feifan's first time traveling far away, and he was afraid that he still didn't understand many places, so he briefly explained the geographical situation.
"Let's go, first go to the village ahead to buy two horses."
After Ye Feiyang finished speaking, he took the lead and walked forward.
"Okay."
After Ye Feifan heard this, he put on his hat and randomly wiped some dust on his face, trying to prevent himself from being easily recognized.
Seeing Ye Feiyang's operation, Ye Feiyang didn't say anything, but his evaluation of Ye Feiyang rose a little more.
Ye Feiyang just said not to let everyone know that Ye Fanfan went to Lingxiao Sect with him, but he did not go into more details. It is true that he did not think too much about this aspect, but after seeing Ye Fanfan's actions, he admitted in his heart that he had not done well enough. Fortunately, Ye Fanfan made up for it a little.
"Brother, I see you always have a long sword on your waist. Are you a swordsman?"
Ye Feifan couldn't help but ask as he and Ye Feiyang moved forward.
He has always been curious about this question. After all, sword cultivators in previous novels were all existences with unparalleled combat power. If the eldest brother was a sword cultivator, he might be able to live more comfortably in Lingxiao Sect. After all, the stronger the backer, the better.
"I'm not a swordsman, I just chose the martial arts in the direction of the sword, so I always carry the sword."
"Brother, do you hope to become a swordsman?? Aren’t all swordsmen great? "
Ye Feifan continued to ask.
"It's difficult. I met sword cultivators when I was traveling before. Their combat power is indeed much higher in the same realm. I also tried to learn how to become a sword cultivator, but I never got started. I heard that you need to master the sword's will. Unfortunately, I didn't feel any sword's will. Maybe I don't have talent in this area. "
Ye Feiyang seems to have planned to become a sword cultivator, but has never succeeded.
"Then after eldest brother becomes a disciple of Lingxiao Sect this time, he will hopefully become a sword cultivator.
After all, in such a large sect, there must be sword cultivators, and it would be even better if they could become their masters by then. "
Ye Feifan strongly agreed with Ye Feiyang to become a sword cultivator, leaning against a big tree to enjoy the shade.
"You think too simply. There is no famous sword cultivator in the entire Yangzhou region, let alone the Lingxiao Sect. I heard that there are specialized sword cultivators in other regions, but it is a pity that they are too far away from us. "
“Oh, that’s such a shame. "
Ye Feifan really felt pity, not only for Ye Feiyang, but also for himself. To be honest, Ye Feifan also had a dream of becoming a sword cultivator.
